label: Heat-treated yoghurt
comment: Yoghurt with both its bacteria, and a probiotic strain besides. Yoghurt heated again once it has set: the live bacteria are gone, and it keeps.

about.text: Yoghurt that is heated again after it has set, so that its bacteria are killed and it keeps for weeks or, with a hotter heat and a sterile fill, months without a fridge. Pectin or another stabiliser stops the gel curdling.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, Fermented milk products

facts.v: In a lab study of stirred ambient yoghurt (S. thermophilus, fermented to pH 4.50), post-heating at or below 65 °C for 25 s kept firmness; hotter gave grainy aggregates
